_written: 2026-10-09, BEFORE computing any strategy return on the pysystemtrade futures panel. Only structure/quality/cost metadata had been inspected (data/metadata/futures_panel_quality.csv, futures_universe.csv).
data: robcarver17/pysystemtrade @bbe29e19 data/futures (GPL-3); loader src/qpl/data/futures_panel.py; universe = futures_panel.universe() (155 instruments; rules in UNIVERSE_RULES)
knowledge_caveat: Trend/carry/XS-momentum/value in futures are published effects whose broad history (2008 crisis alpha, 2011-18 drought, strong 2022) is known to the researcher. Rules are therefore fixed from the literature BEFORE looking; TEST/HOLDOUT are confirmation of published effects in this data, not discovery.

engine.returns: r_t = dADJ_t / PRICE_{t-1}; daily (one obs per calendar date)
engine.risk: sigma_i,t = EWMA(span 35) std of r_i up to t, annualised x sqrt(256), floored at 5th pct of its own trailing 5y history (known at t)
engine.position: w_i,t = s_i,t * (0.40 / sigma_i,t) / N_t, s in [-1,1], N_t = instruments eligible at t (>= 256 days history)
engine.portfolio_vol_target: scale the whole book by 0.10 / trailing-252d realised vol of the UNscaled book (known at t), capped at 5x
engine.execution: w decided at close t is first held over day t+2 (one full day of extra lag: trade at the next close)
engine.costs: turnover_i * cost_i (fraction of notional, from spreadcosts + commission); stressed 2x and 3x
engine.annualisation: sqrt(256) for Sharpe on daily P&L

benchmark: LONG_RP: s_i = +1 for every eligible instrument (same risk scaling, costs, lag). Every gate requires residual Sharpe vs LONG_RP (OLS beta on daily P&L within the period).

F0_CT1_TRANSFER.primary: CT1 legs per instrument: mean of sign(ret over 20,60,120 days) and Donchian(20,55) states; same Donchian entry/exit as V4; no leverage cap (equal-risk legs)
F0_CT1_TRANSFER.purpose: out-of-domain test of the frozen crypto idea

F1_TSMOM.source: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012) Time series momentum, JFE

F2_EWMAC.primary: mean of 4 crossovers (8/32,16/64,32/128,64/256): (EMA_f - EMA_s)/(sigma_price), scaled so mean |forecast| ~ 1, capped +-2, then /2

F3_CARRY.primary: carry_yield / sigma, 21-day mean, scaled by its trailing-5y mean |.|, capped +-2, /2
F3_CARRY.source: Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen & Vrugt (2018) Carry, JFE

F4_XS_MOM.primary: within asset class, rank 252-day minus last-21-day return / sigma; long top third, short bottom third (s = +-1), classes with >= 4 eligible members
F4_XS_MOM.source: Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen (2013) Value and momentum everywhere, JF

F5_XS_VALUE.primary: within asset class, rank MINUS the return from t-1260 to t-252 days (5y reversal); long cheapest third, short dearest third

F6_SKEW.primary: within asset class, rank MINUS 252-day skewness of daily returns; long low-skew third, short high-skew third
F6_SKEW.source: Fernandez-Perez, Frijns, Fuertes & Miffre (2018) The skewness of commodity futures returns, JBF

F7_COMBO.primary: equal-risk average of the surviving families' instrument signals (families passing VALIDATION), defined only after VALIDATION results, before TEST

gates.DISCOVERY: primary net Sharpe >= 0.4 AND residual vs LONG_RP >= 0.2 AND >= 70% of neighbours net > 0
gates.TEST: single look: net Sharpe > 0 AND residual > 0 AND net > 0 at 2x costs
gates.HOLDOUT: single look, only after TEST pass: net Sharpe > 0 AND residual > 0 AND net > 0 at 2x costs

statuses.pass HOLDOUT: ELIGIBLE_FOR_INDEPENDENT_VALIDATION (published effect confirmed in this data; prospective paper next)

multiple_testing: report all primaries and neighbours; Holm across family primaries at each stage (t from Newey-West on daily P&L); PBO across the full grid on DISCOVERY+VALIDATION
